DEFAULT.title: DEFAULT · Warm Contemporary
DEFAULT.tagline: Bed faces the balcony, wardrobe fills the alcove, study-dresser on the thick wall.
DEFAULT.why: It uses every piece of the L-shaped room for what it is best at. The 5'4" x 3'4" alcove beside the door is exactly the size of a 3-door wardrobe, so storage costs no floor space. The bed sits on the only long solid wall (east) and faces the 10'5" balcony opening, giving the best view and morning light. The 7'3" thick south wall becomes a study-cum-dresser. That leaves a clear 5'8" zone between the bed and the balcony and a 3'10" walkway from the door. Aluminium sliders, laminate and vitrified tile are standard, affordable and low-maintenance in Indian conditions.

sections.Layout: Queen bed (5'x6'6") on east wall facing west; bedside tables both sides; study/dresser 4' on thick-wall face; compact lounge chair + floor lamp on north wall; 5'x7' rug.
sections.Wardrobe: 3-door hinged, 5'3" x 2' x 7'6" in the SE alcove + loft to ceiling. Off-white matt laminate with oak inset strips, black profile handles, soft-close hinges. Clears the door jamb by 2".
sections.Window W1: 3-track aluminium sliding window (charcoal): 2 glass shutters (5 mm toughened, clear) + 1 SS-304 mosquito-mesh shutter. Flat-bar MS safety grill outside the glass, colour-matched. Black granite inner sill with 4" ledge + external drip sill. Sheer + sage blackout drape on ceiling track.
sections.Balcony door: 3-track, 3-panel aluminium slider (1 fixed + 2 sliding), 8 mm clear toughened glass, charcoal frame, D-handle with multipoint lock. Opens 2/3 of the 10'5" width. Retractable pleated mosquito mesh. Black granite threshold with low-profile track, 2" step down, sloped nosing (water check). Full-width sheer + blackout drapes stacking at both ends.
sections.Ceiling & lighting: Gypsum perimeter band 1'7" wide, 6" drop (curtain pelmet on balcony side), central raft at slab level. 2700K LED cove, 7 downlights in the band, 2 adjustable reading wall lights, floor lamp, desk shelf light.
sections.Balcony: Anti-skid outdoor tile; built-in teak/WPC bench with cushions against the solid wall (south end); 18" round side table; vertical-garden panel above bench; areca palm + snake plant at north end; 3 railing planters; IP65 up-down wall light.
sections.Palette: Oak, off-white, sage green, rust accents, charcoal metal, warm greige floor.

OPTION_A.title: Option A · Japandi Calm
OPTION_A.tagline: Low platform bed against a slatted thick wall, desk under the window.
OPTION_A.why: A calmer, more natural room. The bed moves to the thick south wall with an ash slat wall as headboard, and the desk takes the window light. Sliding wardrobe doors avoid swing clearance.

sections.Wardrobe: 2-door sliding, ash veneer with grooves, 8'5" high with open top niche for baskets.
sections.Window W1: White uPVC casement pair (outward, friction stays) with 6.38 mm laminated safety glass - no grill; internal roller mesh; solid-wood display sill; bamboo roman blind.
sections.Balcony door: White uPVC 2-track 4-panel slider (fixed-slide-slide-fixed), horizontal roller insect screen, Kota-stone threshold, natural linen curtains on a wooden rod.
sections.Ceiling & lighting: No gypsum false ceiling. Suspended ash slat raft over the bed, rice-paper pendants, surface downlights.
sections.Balcony: WPC deck tiles, floor cushions + low tea table, bamboo privacy screen on railing, palms in terracotta, solar paper lantern.
sections.Palette: Light ash, warm white, linen, moss green, black accents, light-oak plank tile.

OPTION_B.title: Option B · Minimal Modern
OPTION_B.tagline: Bed on the north wall, TV/dresser wall on the thick wall, lounge corner by the balcony.
OPTION_B.why: The most different arrangement. The bed's head goes on the north wall beside the window, so the thick wall can host a TV/media and dresser wall viewed from the bed. A reading lounge sits at the balcony corner. Everything is flush and handleless.

sections.Ceiling & lighting: Flush gypsum ceiling at 9'5" with recessed blind pocket and 2 linear LED lines; hidden LED in headboard panel; wall-mounted swing-arm reading light beside the window (kept clear of the inward-opening sash).
sections.Balcony: Grey porcelain, fold-down railing table + 2 slim metal chairs, 2 tall concrete-look planters, linear wall light.
sections.Palette: White, warm grey, charcoal, walnut, black metal.

OPTION_C.title: Option C · Indian Modern Heritage
OPTION_C.tagline: Cane headboard wall, built-in diwan, bi-fold doors that open the whole balcony.
OPTION_C.why: The premium, distinctive option. A 4-panel bi-fold door folds away completely, so the room and balcony become one space. Cane, teak, brass, block prints and a built-in diwan give it an Indian character without hotel styling.

sections.Ceiling & lighting: Single-step tray ceiling (2'2" band at 9'3") with cove LED and teak edge strip; large cane pendant; brass-trim downlights.
sections.Balcony: Leather-finish Kota stone, rattan armchair + cane side table, terracotta planters (tulsi, jasmine, bougainvillea), pierced brass lantern, jute dhurrie.
